# rauthy_password_policy (Resource)

Password policy resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `length_max` (Number) Maximum length of password
- `length_min` (Number) Minimum length of password

### Optional

- `include_digits` (Number) Number of digits required in password
- `include_lower_case` (Number) Number of lowercase letters required in password
- `include_special` (Number) Number of special characters required in password
- `include_upper_case` (Number) Number of uppercase letters required in password
- `not_recently_used` (Number) Number of previous passwords that cannot be reused
- `valid_days` (Number) Number of days before password expires
